name: Nagging Wife
overview: Scripture highlights the profound impact a wife's character and behavior have on her household and husband. A virtuous and discreet woman is portrayed as a crown and a builder of her home, while a contentious or foolish wife brings shame, continual strife, and destruction to her family. The Proverbs warn that living with a quarrelsome or angry wife is so difficult that it is better to dwell alone in undesirable places than to endure constant nagging and brawling within a wide house.
